newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Yugoslav customs officials seize heroin at border.
newsitem.headline: Yugoslav customs officials seize heroin at border.

text.p: Yugoslav customs officials seized 190 kg (420 pounds) of heroin concealed among a truckload of peppers at the Yugoslav-Bulgarian border, Belgrade newspapers reported on Monday.
The street market value of the drugs was estimated at around 200 million German marks or $130 million dollars, police were quoted as saying.

The Slovenian-registered truck with its 20-tonne cargo of peppers was stopped at the Gradina border crossing on its way from Bulgaria to Slovenia at the weekend, police said. The driver was detained in connection with what the police described as the biggest single drug shipment found at a border crossing in former Yugoslavia.
